headline: New York opened a registration portal for its RAISE Act
body: New York opened a registration portal for its RAISE Act on Tuesday. Large frontier AI developers like Anthropic and OpenAI will be required to register by January 1, 2027, and have to publish safety frameworks and report critical safety incidents within 72 hours.
note: The duties fall on large frontier developers, and the safety frameworks and transparency reports they have to publish are the parts a bank could read when it uses their models.

evidence.text: The state opened a registration portal Tuesday, with which large frontier AI developers like Anthropic and OpenAI will be required to register by January 1, 2027.
The RAISE Act , New York’s safety and transparency bill, kicks in at the start of the year.

It mandates that large frontier developers — companies with more than $500 million in annual revenue — have to publish safety frameworks on their websites, report critical safety incidents within 72 hours, and issue public model transparency reports.
